ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 75-80% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated primarily in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) region centered around the median notch and extending downward into the peduncle. Discrete low-intensity spots include a small oval on the mid-left lobe and several irregular clusters on the inner-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across the trailing boundary. Significant jagged peaks and non-uniform indentations are localized on the distal third of the right lobe; left lobe edge displays more uniform, low-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory from the notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp points; the right lobe tip shows a steeper downward curvature compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white pixels are visible at the terminal tips of both lobes, most prominently on the far left distal edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are mapped across the medial and lower-distal regions of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular geometric loss (jagged notch) on the far right trailing edge; visible linear rake marks on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated high-contrast dark circular spot is located on the interior-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
